vietnam chicken rice
Nov 2023 • Solo
when i visited cho lon in HCM, i noticed this famous chicken rice shop. there are two or more branches in HCM, that one i visited is located in district 5. i ordered chicken rice combo which consists of one plate of dong nguyen chicken rice with char siu, one bowl of Pork shank, watercress and jujube soup and one cabbage with sauce,i also ordered a big glass of chrysanthemum tea drinks with honey. chicken rice here quite similar to Hainan chicken rice, but not exactly same,it is Vietnam style chicken rice, anyway, you cant compare both, it has its own style, and i think it is tasty, worth a visit. the soup is fresh too. the place here quite big, if you want to try vietnam chicken rice, Dong Nguyen is highly recommended!

Rare Gem From The Past
Apr 2018 • Friends
Here in Saigon, most of the legendary eateries of the golden pre-75 era of culinary have disappeared or have been bastardized beyond recognition. Đong Nguyên chicken steamed rice is not one of them. Still standing since 1945 and proudly dishing out its fabulous steamed chicken and, incredibly, their black whole chicken in herbs and traditional medicine soup. I know of no other place that even have this mythical soup. If chicken soup is known to cure a cold, black chicken cooked with traditional Chinese medicine is a cure-all super drug that fix everything including dysfunctional erection. 
For a glimpse of how Chinese food was like or ought to be, come to Đong Nguyên.
